what_it_does: This is a reproducibility report and artifact evaluation for an SC25 conference paper. The original research addresses the challenge of co-optimizing the physical communication topology (how computers are connected to each other) and data placement strategies for training graph neural networks across multiple GPUs when the data is too large to fit in a single GPU's memory. The report verifies whether the original paper's results can be independently reproduced by following the authors' methods and code.
